JARVIS command centre ? v22

The desktop now has a layered reactor and angular telemetry panels. Existing tray color, monitor, transparency, animation and pause settings still apply.

The voice display shows what recognition heard, your current request phase, JARVIS's response and recent app/tool activity. These are actual session states; the preview image uses an example transcript for demonstration. Spoken replies still pronounce VEYDR as Vader.

This release changes the interface. It does not add autonomous screen reading or new PC permissions. The whole HUD stays stationary while its internal reactor rings animate. Use tray FPS/animation controls to adjust motion.
